name: pdk-etebase-gap-free-stoken-sync
instr:
# Proposal: gap-free collection synchronization

## Background
Etebase clients need to resume collection and item lists across concurrent workers without losing committed changes. They use opaque stokens for HTTP polling, Redis-backed websocket subscriptions for item announcements, and memberships to control access to shared collections.

## Proposal
Support concurrent API workers without losing a committed revision when stokens are allocated in one transaction but other transactions commit first. A client can reconcile websocket traffic and time spent offline by resuming the HTTP feed with the last received token.

## Requirements
- Across collections, repeated `GET /api/v1/collection/` with `stoken` must return every newly changed collection without skipping an earlier uncommitted change, even if later writes commit first. Polls after concurrent writers converge without duplicate collection IDs; the returned `stoken` remains safe for another poll.
- A subscription ticket from `POST /api/v1/collection/{collection_uid}/item/subscription-ticket/` opens `/api/v1/ws/{ticket}/`. Its item notifications include `data` and a resumable `stoken` and arrive within 12 seconds of a new item write; an HTTP item resync from the notified token retrieves changes made while disconnected, without redelivering earlier items.
